title: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 2/Moves
text:
With more tricks in Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 2, players can now pick and choose with trick goes in which control slot. Skaters can have up to twelve flip tricks, twelve grab tricks, four lip tricks, and five special moves. Only grinds and manuals cannot be changed. Doing the same trick in a session will lower it's value, up to a tenth of its original score. However, doing the same trick in switch stance counts as a new trick that with its own value deprecation and it gives a 1.2x bonus to the trick's score on regular stance. Note that any score with a + means that it can be held down continuously for extra points.
